designation: BEFORE THE NATIONAL COMPANY LAW TRIBUNAL
jurisdictionNote: National Company Law Tribunal constituted under Section 408 of the Companies Act, 2013. Adjudicating authority for corporate insolvency resolution and liquidation under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. Appellate forum: NCLAT (uses the same rule file).

localRules: Pleadings governed by the NCLT Rules, 2016 and the Insolvency and Bankruptcy (Application to Adjudicating Authority) Rules, 2016 for IBC matters.
IBC applications under Sections 7, 9, 10 require prescribed forms (Form 1 / Form 5 / Form 6 respectively) with statutory annexures.
Court fee payable as per Schedule of Fees under NCLT Rules; IBC Section 7/9 applications attract Rs. 25,000 / Rs. 2,000 respectively.
Affidavit verifying the petition must be on non-judicial stamp paper as per the State where filed.
E-filing through e-Court / NCLT portal where enabled by the bench; physical filing remains permissible.
Appeals from NCLT lie to NCLAT within 45 days under Section 421 Companies Act / Section 61 IBC.
